findings.title: [P1] Restore tenant scoping in document lookup
findings.body: Any authenticated user who supplies another tenant's document ID now receives that document. The diff removes `tenantId: ctx.user.tenantId` from the `where` clause of the `findFirst` call in `getDocument` (removed old lines 33–34, replaced by `id,` alone), so the query is keyed solely on caller-controlled input. This is a cross-tenant broken-access-control (IDOR) regression: the previous code enforced the user's tenant boundary on every lookup, and this PR drops that enforcement while the surrounding code still assumes per-request user scoping. It contradicts the PR's own claim of preserving existing contracts.
